opening.argument: Although the material is packaged as an explanation, its practical effect can be promotional. The description then directs viewers to cryptocurrency investment and trading courses, including claims about funding retirement and achieving daily wins. The presentation therefore should be read not only as neutral education, but as reputation-backed promotion that encourages crypto participation.
